A2 bilona ghee online: is your ghee really bilona? 🪔 Label Check #3

Before you light the Karthika deepam, flip your ghee jar and check 3 things:
1️⃣ Method: does it say made from curd (bilona), not from cream or butter?
2️⃣ Milk: does it name the milk, like A2 milk of desi cows?
3️⃣ Ingredients: is milk fat the only thing in it?
